a: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
p: Fa-idhā quḍiyati-ṣ-ṣalātu fa-ntashirū fi-l-arḍi wa-btaghū min faḍli-llāhi wa-dhkuru-llāha kathīran laʿallakum tufliḥūn.
m: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
